asset.title: One platform for the whole model lifecycle
asset.purpose: Explain how immutable model and data identities become compiled, evidence-gated programs that run across training, evaluation, composition, and serving in one shared runtime.

source_analysis.visual_metaphor: A Go-powered factory converts model artifacts into verified multimodal capabilities while OvergoDB acts as the content-addressed authority beneath the production line.

style.setting: outdoor factory in a bright mountain landscape
style.characters: Go gophers acting as inspectors, operators, builders, evaluators, and release managers
style.linework: thick black ink outlines with lightly irregular hand lettering

hierarchy: left-to-right intake, compilation, runtime, and output pipeline
bottom evidence loop and right-side lifecycle legend

upgrade.message: Immutable authority, compiled plans, bounded execution, and exact evidence connect every model lifecycle capability.
upgrade.design_strategy: Keep the simpler factory and OvergoDB foundation, preserve readable panel labels, and add only the durable workflow, interaction, catalog, and GUI capabilities that materially clarify the current system.
preserve: mountain landscape and hand-drawn visual style

enhanced_elements.heading: PLAN COMPILERS
enhanced_elements.visual: four blueprint sheets feed one strict typed compiler; rejected sheets exit through a red refusal chute
enhanced_elements.reason: Overgo compiles more than runtime recipes; training, evaluation, and composition each have exact immutable plan identities.

enhanced_elements.heading: SHARED RESIDENT RUNTIME
enhanced_elements.visual: existing terminal plus a visible capacity gauge, waiting queue, device-residency lights, and idle-eviction clock
enhanced_elements.reason: The runtime now has explicit admission, capacity, waiting, component lifetime, residency, and eviction behavior.

enhanced_elements.heading: OVERGODB
enhanced_elements.visual: central locked database with immutable records entering on the left and compare-and-set alias pointers moving on the right
enhanced_elements.reason: Identity, physical location, composition, evidence, and active names are separate authorities.

enhanced_elements.heading: EVIDENCE-BOUND ACTIVATION
enhanced_elements.visual: gold strip with the Gate and Decide steps shown as separate checkpoints before a compare-and-set activation switch
enhanced_elements.reason: Promotion is an explicit decision and atomic alias transition, not an automatic consequence of a passing metric.

enhanced_elements.heading: EXACT EVALUATION
enhanced_elements.visual: evaluator gopher stamps a plan containing model, recipe, data, scorer, code, environment, and lifecycle seals
enhanced_elements.reason: Evaluation binds every authority before execution and preserves record-level failures.

enhanced_elements.heading: EXACT TRAINING
enhanced_elements.visual: training gopher checks a checkpoint key containing weights, optimizer plan, RNG, processors, codecs, projectors, and stream position
enhanced_elements.reason: Resume authority includes the entire executable and data state, not only checkpoint bytes.

enhanced_elements.heading: WORKBENCH
enhanced_elements.visual: laptop shows catalog coverage and download progress beside shared live operations, stage receipts, decisions, interaction replay, and resident-session activity
enhanced_elements.reason: The GUI now exposes multi-task model discovery, architecture-profile and dataset coverage, verified Hub downloads, shared SSE runtime state, durable workflow evidence, interaction replay, composition, evaluation, and model analysis.

new_elements.visual: a concise callout beside the Workbench names the three catalog denominators exposed by the Library surface
new_elements.reason: Catalog output now distinguishes registered architecture profiles, registered datasets, and promoted capabilities across every task.

new_elements.heading: COMPOSITION
new_elements.visual: two small model machines feed different colored representations through a bridge into one target model; a lock indicates active-alias authority
new_elements.reason: Cross-model representation bridging and exact-lineage offline composition are production lifecycle capabilities.

new_elements.heading: ADMISSION & PLACEMENT
new_elements.visual: railway switchyard with a capacity gauge routes request cards to host or GPU tracks; excess work parks in a bounded siding
new_elements.reason: Request parking and scheduling are structural runtime contracts rather than hidden operational behavior.

new_elements.heading: IDENTITY-BOUND CACHE
new_elements.visual: five-key lock on cached transformed representations, separate from a target KV-cache box
new_elements.reason: Transformed-source cache reuse is valid only when every transformation authority matches.

new_elements.heading: STREAMING OBJECTS
new_elements.visual: artifact blocks move through a bounded pipe from external storage while only identities and locations enter OvergoDB
new_elements.reason: Large model and dataset bytes remain external while OvergoDB binds their immutable identities and locations.

new_elements.heading: STRUCTURAL GATES
new_elements.visual: an inspector traces changed gears through connected machinery; uncertain paths lead to more tests, never a skipped gate
new_elements.reason: Verification scope derives from changed symbols and ownership, with run-by-default behavior when analysis cannot prove independence.

new_elements.heading: ACTIVE ALIAS
new_elements.visual: a guarded railway switch moves one illuminated alias pointer from the prior recipe to the promoted recipe
new_elements.reason: Evidence-gated activation is a compare-and-set transition with an explicit decision and rollback target.

icon_language.identity: database cylinder with fingerprint or hash shield
icon_language.resident_session: lit device slot with lease clock
icon_language.evidence: sealed document with exact identity links
icon_language.rollback: circular arrow to recorded prior state
icon_language.composition: two colored streams connected by a typed bridge

copy_rules.capitalization: uppercase panel headings; sentence case for labels
avoid: model-family-specific claims in the shared runtime
unqualified words such as automatic, universal, or unlimited
suggesting that implemented means verified or promoted
suggesting that OvergoDB stores all model and dataset bytes
suggesting that a passing metric activates a recipe without a decision

rendering_constraints: Keep every label large enough to read at README width.
Use arrows only for actual dependency or lifecycle direction.
Show refusal paths and rollback paths, not only the happy path.
Keep source and target representation colors distinct through the composition bridge.
Keep external object bytes visually outside OvergoDB; show OvergoDB retaining identities and locations.
Separate transformed-source cache from target KV cache.
Depict bounded queues with visible capacity rather than an open-ended line.
Do not increase total small-print density over the source image; replace detail with icons or grouped labels.
acceptance_checks: The graphic reads as intake -> compile -> admit -> execute -> output at first glance.
Composition is visible as a peer of training and evaluation.
OvergoDB clearly separates immutable identities from mutable active aliases.
Evaluation visibly binds model, recipe, dataset split, scorer, code, environment, and lifecycle before execution.
Training resume visibly binds weights, optimizer plan, RNG, processors, codecs or projectors, and stream position.
Admission shows bounded capacity, bounded waiting, data locality, and eviction.
Activation shows evidence, an explicit decision, compare-and-set semantics, and rollback.
The four lifecycle states remain visually distinct.
The visual remains approachable and recognizably related to the source image.
